subject.title: Prompt-cache prefix churn on OpenAI models: per-turn dynamic injections (message tool hint + volatile system-prompt section) defeat automatic prefix caching

question: Should OpenClaw change `message_tool_only` delivery guidance now so it no longer changes OpenAI cache-sensitive tool/schema and stable prompt bytes, or wait for fresh current-main live telemetry before choosing the fix shape?
rationale: The bug is source-backed, but the durable fix crosses prompt assembly, tool schema stability, and visible reply delivery behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before an automated repair changes that contract.

options.title: Approve focused cache-stability repair
options.body: Move or stabilize the per-turn delivery guidance so OpenAI sees a byte-stable cached prefix, then require focused unit coverage plus a live cache trace against current main.

options.title: Collect live telemetry first
options.body: Keep the issue open under maintainer review until a current-main OpenAI run quantifies the remaining miss rate after the recent prompt-boundary refactor.

options.title: Defer as accepted cost
options.body: Leave the delivery guidance as-is and document that message-tool-only orchestrator turns can reduce OpenAI prompt-cache reuse.

recommendation.title: Approve focused cache-stability repair
recommendation.body: Move or stabilize the per-turn delivery guidance so OpenAI sees a byte-stable cached prefix, then require focused unit coverage plus a live cache trace against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The current mode-dependent prompt and tool-description lines blame to this recent area commit and PR metadata, making this the best available owner for the implementation-shape choice.
